description: Writes bounded Markdown content into the managed local WebCross export directory.

content.description: Markdown content to save as a local artifact.

fileName.description: Markdown file name without path separators. Defaults to the current task or execution ID.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing Markdown file may be replaced.

purpose.description: Describe why the Markdown artifact should be saved locally and identify the export being produced.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the WebCross export root.

bytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the saved content.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the saved artifact.

overwritten.description: Whether an existing file was replaced.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.
